name: Just Another Day in Paradise
source:
The Swarm is gone, but danger remains. Survive a day in Snoqualmie Falls, shape your relationships, and reveal the creatures haunting the woods.

[From [url=https://tripelle.itch.io/just-another-day-in-paradise]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
虫群消失了，但危险依然存在。在斯诺夸尔米瀑布生存一天，塑造你的人际关系，并揭开森林里出没的生物的面纱。

[来自[url=https://tripelle.itch.io/just-another-day-in-paradise]Itch.io[/url]]
